Method of Attack: Exploitation of CVE-2023-4966 vulnerability to steal authentication sessions and hijack accounts
Bypassing multifactor authentication or other strong auth requirements
Impacted Systems: NetScaler ADC appliances configured as Gateway (VPN virtual server, ICA Proxy, CVPN, RDP Proxy)
NetScaler ADC appliances configured as AAA virtual server
Attack Vector: Remote exploitation of CVE-2023-4966 vulnerability in NetScaler ADC and Gateway appliances
Unauthenticated attackers exploiting low-complexity attacks without user interaction
Indicators of Compromise: Exploitation reported by Mandiant one week after patch release
CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities Catalog listing CVE-2023-4966
